items.problem: Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 emits a false '[WARN] MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md exists with content but mapping has no defer rows — check consistency' on every migration that defers nothing, even when everything is correct.
items.evidence: session-log.txt Turn 31 (line 2245) and Turn 33 (line 2277): the WARN appears in both validator runs; the run still reaches 'Validate-UwpMigration: PASS'. MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md contains only the seeded '| (none) | — |' placeholder.
items.skill_search: Grepped Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 and Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 for 'DEFERRED', 'No items deferred', '(none)'.
items.wrong_text_if_any: Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 (~line 268): if ($deferText -notmatch 'No items deferred') { Write-Host "[WARN] MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md exists with content but mapping has no defer rows — check consistency" } else { Write-Host "[PASS] No defer rows; MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md correctly notes 'No items deferred.'" }
items.root_cause: The validator's no-defer PASS path keys off the literal sentinel 'No items deferred', but Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 (~line 480) seeds the empty state as a '| (none) | — |' table row and never writes that phrase. The two scripts are out of sync, so the PASS branch is unreachable and the WARN always fires when nothing is deferred.
items.proposed_fix: In Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 §4 no-defer branch, decide PASS/WARN structurally: count real DEFERRED table data rows, excluding the header/separator and the seeded '| (none) |' placeholder. PASS when zero real rows; WARN only when the DEFERRED file lists actual files while the mapping has no defer rows (the genuine inconsistency).
items.generalizes: Every UWP→WinUI 3 migration where no file touches an unsupported API defers nothing — a very common case across scenarios. Any such run currently gets a misleading WARN that can send the agent chasing a non-existent problem. Aligning the validator with the bootstrap's actual seed removes the false signal for all of them.
